question: Can either the full observation or an ROI-local-plus-shared encoding predict which valid ROI has the lowest immediate counterfactual error?

features.full_101: all obs_000..obs_100 plus 12-column ROI one-hot (113 features)
features.local_shared: candidate obs_{7*k}..obs_{7*k+6} plus obs_084..obs_100 and 12-column ROI one-hot (36 features)

hypotheses.H1: probe regret is lower than majority
hypotheses.H2: probe regret is lower than shuffled
hypotheses.H3: probe regret is lower than PPO factual

limits: single-hop counterfactuals do not form sequential trajectories
free hops are conditioned on PPO behavior
no sequential MAE comparison to PPO
